candidates.name: RouteFirstFit
candidates.hypothesis: 只改A4。核心是改变写线的内部工作顺序：先完整理解并选择ROUTES，确定每段已经成立的处境、具体所求和顾虑，再从这条经历写出分段要点；最后才检查TARGETS，必要时调整情境表达和covers。TARGETS不能反过来决定人物发生了什么。它与TargetVector不同，不改变A3，也不先建立多维体验映射；它与旧N05整篇散文主线不同，不先写不分段的完整文章再转换成关系图，而是在原有段落结构内完成两轮综合。
candidates.risk: 可能让A4过度依赖ROUTES，导致目标覆盖变弱，或使某些听感只被宽泛的情绪对应。它也不能自动修复路线本身已有的重复。它与历史整篇主线写作的区别是保留原有分段结构、引用和每段2—4条要求，不另写散文再转换；与同提示词重抽的区别是改变了任务顺序和TARGETS的权限。必须同时测覆盖、单独成立和人话，不能只看文字变得简洁。

candidates.downstream_required: Checkpoint-only; rerun affected accepted N05e/N05f and final against actual then-current mainline if survivor.

dedup_reassessment: Re-read both complete original generic prompts: AnchorFirst constructs anchor inventory before TARGETS, then writes final; RouteFirstFit explicitly writes the complete segmented experience first, then checks TARGETS and can only change expression focus. Previously deferred as overlap; now test this lighter synthesis order variant once, without claiming direct observation of internal reasoning or clean causal attribution. Both use exact same original A1/A2/A3. Not a new upstream mechanism or same-prompt redraw.
